8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: I was woken up in the middle of the night by the Golden Guard. Due to the sensitivity of the information, I had to be urgently briefed in person.

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "Do you know what this is about?"

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Titus? Why am I being disturbed at this hour?"

12.speaker: Titus Gordion
12.text: "I was told to come and get you, Your Majesty. I believe there is an important situation that needs your immediate attention."

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: When we arrived at the doors to the Council of Chambers, Uncle Hugo greeted me.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: I put on my clothes and followed Titus through the corridors of the palace.

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: He tugged on my arm, leaned in, and whispered.

23.speaker: Hugo Toras
23.text: "I'm afraid we'll be facing our biggest crisis yet. I must stress -- this is the time everybody needs a calm and resilient leadership."

24.speaker: Hugo Toras
24.text: "Make sure you are ready. I'm sure you'll do the right thing."

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: He took a long look at me and my clothes that I'd rushed to put on.

26.speaker: Hugo Toras
26.text: "Your butler couldn't be summoned in time, I take it."

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: He put his hand on my shoulder.

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "You're not making this any easier. I need to know what happened. Right now."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "I don't have time for this. Just step inside and let me in, so we can discuss it properly."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "Don't be cryptic with me. You are supposed to be my Grand Vizier."

32.speaker: Hugo Toras
32.text: "You are right. Let's just go in."

34.speaker: Narrator
34.text: He opened the doors for us and we entered a scene of barely restrained chaos. The councillors were already gathered inside, their faces etched with lines of worry.

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: As the king, I knew such a summons could only mean dire news.

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: Upon my entrance, they all stood up immediately.

38.speaker: Lucita Azaro
38.text: "Your Majesty... We have an emergency to report."

39.speaker: Lucita Azaro
39.text: "A very serious incident at sea, around the Aureus gas field, has unfolded."

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: Lucita approached me with a calm demeanor that contrasted with the anxious atmosphere inside. She bowed and spoke.

44.speaker: Lucita Azaro
44.text: "I wish there was another way to put this. The Grand Duchy of Pales has committed an act of war."

45.speaker: Lucita Azaro
45.text: "A very serious incident at our southern border with Pales has unfolded."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "An act of war? I'm sure there's a misunderstanding."
46.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HostileToPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Intention_Pales_Aggressive"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == true) == false

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "This sounds serious. Let's just calm down and start from the beginning."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "Ah... The conflict we've all been waiting for."

51.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
51.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_HostileToPales"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Intention_Pales_Aggressive"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Military_BlockDrillship"] == true) == false

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: There was a brief silence. Nobody responded.

55.speaker: Lucita Azaro
55.text: "This is what we know so far..."

56.speaker: Lucita Azaro
56.text: "About an hour ago, we received grave news. To put it mildly."

57.speaker: Lucita Azaro
57.text: "Approximately an hour ago, a violent exchange erupted between our soldiers and Palesian forces at our border near Fort Ales."

58.speaker: Elena Werner
58.text: "Yes. Navar Castle is one of the most well-preserved Rezenid-era paleaccis outside of Pales. It is on a small islet on the River Alca -- directly at our border."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "There is something fishy about this. I need more details."

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "Are we absolutely sure they shot at us first?"

62.speaker: Hugo Toras
62.text: "I agree. The timing is too perfect. We were about to sign the deal to transfer the extraction rights of Aureus to us."

63.speaker: Lucita Azaro
63.text: "It appears they made a bold and bloody incursion. They've crossed the river and taken refuge in Navar Castle."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Okay. That's the last straw. If they want war, we'll bring them war."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Don't make me laugh. Are you saying Pales is invading us?"

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "WHAT!? How could such an attack even take place?"

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "Paleaccis? Are you saying they are after a medieval castle?"

70.speaker: Hugo Toras
70.text: "This is highly symbolic though. Pales is the land of the paleaccis. It is their national identity."

71.speaker: Lucita Azaro
71.text: "No, Your Majesty. I would not say that."

73.speaker: Lucita Azaro
73.text: "Not necessarily, Your Majesty. I would not say that."

74.speaker: Lucita Azaro
74.text: "I will do everything in my ability to get to the root of this, Your Majesty."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "May the Divine's embrace be upon them, as they return to the source of all creation."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "Those six represented more than numbers, they were sons of Rizia. Make sure their families are properly taken care of."

79.speaker: Hugo Toras
79.text: "The fact they took control of a paleaccis is highly symbolic. Pales is the land of the paleaccis. It is their national identity."

80.speaker: Elena Werner
80.text: "The choice of the target definitely doesn't seem like a coincidence."

81.speaker: Lucita Azaro
81.text: "The report from the border force states that our soldiers were patrolling just outside of the castle when they were shot at."

84.speaker: Lucita Azaro
84.text: "Unfortunately as I've stated before, they have taken refuge in the castle during the firefight and they are still inside."

89.speaker: Lucita Azaro
89.text: "It is too early to be certain. We are currently relying on the preliminary news we've received."

90.speaker: Lucita Azaro
90.text: "However, the report of the commanding officer implicitly states they were 'attacked' while they were on patrol duty."

91.speaker: Hugo Toras
91.text: "There is something incredibly shady about this. The timing and how the incident took place."

92.speaker: Lucita Azaro
92.text: "It is too early to be certain about anything. We are currently relying on the preliminary news we've received."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "And do we know how many of them are there right now?"

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "The real question is: why are they still alive?"

95.speaker: Lucita Azaro
95.text: "I would like to know the answer to that question myself, Your Majesty."

96.speaker: Lucita Azaro
96.text: "During the brief firefight, the Palesians managed to cross our border at the Alca River."

98.speaker: Lucita Azaro
98.text: "The commanding officer at the border suspects at least a dozen."

99.speaker: Lucita Azaro
99.text: "According to one onlooker, the first shot was fired from our side directly from the paleaccis. But I find it hard to believe that."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Mr. Esquibel, what is your opinion on this incident?"

102.speaker: Player_Romus
102.text: "It is too early to be certain of anything. We cannot act without establishing proper communication channels with Pales."

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "But what is your opinion, Duchess? Do you believe the reports?"

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "What say you of this incursion, Hugo, Your Grace?"

105.speaker: Lucita Azaro
105.text: "You're right, Your Majesty. But it seems Pales didn't care about establishing communication before they killed six of our soldiers."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "And what if it's a false flag?"

107.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
107.text: "Your Majesty, it's perplexing. The Palesians gain nothing by occupying an old castle within our borders. Especially considering our cooperation."

108.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
108.text: "Someone is trying to sabotage our deal. I think that's clear."

109.speaker: Hugo Toras
109.text: "It is a possibility. To stir discord among us, or even provoke a harsh retaliation."

110.speaker: Lucita Azaro
110.text: "As I've said, it is too early to be certain about anything. However, there is no reason to doubt the reports coming from our official channels."

111.speaker: Hugo Toras
111.text: "The timing is too perfect for this not to have been planned, Your Majesty."

112.speaker: Hugo Toras
112.text: "But it could also be a ruse, a distraction from their true intentions."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "What if it's a false flag? This can be exactly what they are trying to make us think."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "Do you think it could be a false flag operation?"

120.speaker: Hugo Toras
120.text: "Possibly a false flag operation. To stir discord among us, or even provoke a harsh retaliation."

121.speaker: Hugo Toras
121.text: "It can very well turn out to be a false flag operation. To stir discord among us, or even provoke a harsh retaliation."

122.speaker: Hugo Toras
122.text: "Yes. It could also be a ruse, a distraction from their true intentions."

123.speaker: Lucita Azaro
123.text: "Pales has long been unfriendly towards us and coveted our lands. They wouldn't want to give away their rights to Aureus so easily."

125.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
125.text: "Your Majesty, it's perplexing. The Palesians gain nothing by occupying an old castle within our borders. Especially considering our cooperation."

126.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
126.text: "Someone is trying to sabotage our deal. I think that's clear."

127.speaker: Lucita Azaro
127.text: "This is a blunt show of force, a test of our resolve -- right before the signing of our energy deal."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "What if it's an inside job? Someone who knows our patrols, our weaknesses at the border."

131.speaker: Lucita Azaro
131.text: "Pales has long been unfriendly towards us and coveted our lands. They wouldn't want to give away their rights to Aureus so easily."

133.speaker: Lucita Azaro
133.text: "This is a blunt show of force, a test of our resolve -- right before the signing of our energy deal."

134.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
134.text: "We need to consider all possibilities, Your Majesty."

135.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
135.text: "There is also the possibility that the true provocateur was someone else entirely. An external party who doesn't want us to sign the deal with Pales."
135.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true) == false)

136.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
136.text: "That is a possibility we must seriously consider, Your Majesty."

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "What if it's an inside job? Someone who knows our patrols, our weaknesses at the border."

139.speaker: Player_Romus
139.text: "I highly doubt that Pales would organize an attack like this."

140.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
140.text: "We must consider the possibility of an inside job as well. Someone who knows our patrols and our weaknesses at the borders."

141.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
141.text: "One obvious explanation is that this was an inside job. Someone who knows our patrols and our weaknesses at the borders."

145.speaker: Narrator
145.text: When we arrived at the doors to the council chambers, Hugo and Vina greeted me.

148.speaker: Hugo Toras
148.text: "Apologies for disturbing both of you at this hour. Thank you for being here so quickly."

152.speaker: Hugo Toras
152.text: "We'll talk about how to handle this situation. Could you tell us the details first, Duchess Azaro?"

153.speaker: Player_Romus
153.text: "Hold on. Where is Vina? Did we manage to communicate with her at all?"

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: She pointed at the map showing the border between Rizia and Pales.

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "I'm getting really worried. Please make it quick."

158.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
158.text: "As far as I'm aware, she is supposed to be at the port of Pales."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "It is too early to be certain of anything. We cannot act so hastily while the Princess is in Pales."

164.speaker: Lucita Azaro
164.text: "You're right, Your Majesty. We have to exercise utmost caution. They can even hold her as a hostage if we're not careful."

171.speaker: Vina Toras
171.text: "What if it's neither Pales nor treachery within, but another player on the world stage seeking to embroil us in conflict?"

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: The chamber fell into a restless silence. The theory was as plausible as it was terrifying.

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: I looked upon my council, a tableau of concern, ambition and fear.

176.speaker: Hugo Toras
176.text: "If that's true, then we fell right into his hands by delivering Vina to Pales."
176.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == true)

177.speaker: Lucita Azaro
177.text: "I'm afraid that's the most likely scenario."

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "We must not leap to the drumbeat of war, nor to conclusions. We will investigate this thoroughly. Establish communications with Pales immediately. We will not act until I talk to the Duke myself and demand an explanation."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "We must not leap to the drumbeat of war, nor to conclusions. We cannot afford to be hasty while Vina is in their hands. We will not act until I talk to the Duke myself and demand an explanation."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "I've heard enough. Pales has provoked us for the last time. We will prepare for war."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "Enough! Pales has dared to shed Rizian blood, and such insolence demands retribution. I will show them the might of our kingdom. Prepare for war!"

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "First, we will get rid of those Palesian soldiers who still have the audacity to occupy our land, and then we will get to the bottom of this. I will not talk to the Duke until those soldiers are dealt with."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "We cannot allow those soldiers to kill our people and leave our soil unscathed. Make sure they are eliminated or captured immediately. After that's done, I will talk to the Duke and demand an explanation."

190.speaker: Lucita Azaro
190.text: "Approximately half an hour ago, the ships we sent to enforce our claim to the Aureus gas field fired on and sunk a Palesian vessel."

191.speaker: Narrator
191.text: The councillors fell silent, a shocked look on their faces.

192.speaker: Lucita Azaro
192.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. Our soldiers will march at your command."

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: The councillors fell silent, a resolved look on their faces.

194.speaker: Lucita Azaro
194.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. I will let the commander know about your orders immediately."

195.speaker: Hugo Toras
195.text: "A prudent decision. Our enemies will see hesitation as weakness. We must show them there are repercussions for their actions."

196.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
196.text: "I still believe this to be hasty, Your Majesty. We should first hear what they have to say before conducting any operations on the castle."

200.speaker: Vina Toras
200.text: "But what if this was indeed an inside job or a third party? I fear this path may lead to unnecessary bloodshed. Don't you think it's best to talk to Duke Reinhart before we act?"

201.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
201.text: "I agree with Her Highness, Your Majesty. We should first hear what they have to say before conducting any operations on the castle."

202.speaker: Hugo Toras
202.text: "I believe His Majesty has already made his decision."

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: The councillors fell silent, a questioning look on their faces.

204.speaker: Lucita Azaro
204.text: "Understood, Your Majesty, but let us not delay. Every moment we ponder, Pales grows bolder."

205.speaker: Hugo Toras
205.text: "Our enemies will see hesitation as weakness. If we don't show them there are repercussions for their actions, this will only embolden them."

206.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
206.text: "I agree with your decision, Your Majesty. We have to be calm if we want to find out the truth and reach an understanding with Pales."

210.speaker: Vina Toras
210.text: "I support the decision. We have to be calm if we want to find out the truth and reach an understanding with Pales."

211.speaker: Lucita Azaro
211.text: "The squad on duty was forced to fall back. As a result, the Palesians managed to enter the castle. The commander reported they have surrounded them but waiting for orders before taking any actions."

212.speaker: Lucita Azaro
212.text: "Their other two vessels were immediately surrounded. They are still being kept at the location of the incident."

213.speaker: Hugo Toras
213.text: "It's an outrage! They were warned, yet they encroached upon the field, knowing that our navy would defend it."

214.speaker: Lucita Azaro
214.text: "According to our reports, a small fleet of three Palesian ships advanced directly at our ships despite repeated warnings."

215.speaker: Lucita Azaro
215.text: "The vessel that was sunk was not only warned, it managed to ram into our flagship -- RRN Valero -- damaging it almost beyond repair."

216.speaker: Lucita Azaro
216.text: "Our fleet then acted in retaliation, discharging its weapons at the Palesians and sinking one of their ships."

220.speaker: Hugo Toras
220.text: "We'll talk about how to handle this situation. Could you tell us the details first, Duchess Azaro?"

221.speaker: Player_Romus
221.text: "Hold on. Vina is still in Pales. Did we manage to communicate with her at all?"

222.speaker: Narrator
222.text: She pointed at the freshly printed report on the table.

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "I don't have time to read all that. Tell me exactly what happened."

226.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
226.text: "As far as I'm aware, she is supposed to be at the port of Pales."

228.speaker: Elena Werner
228.text: "That's true. Our fleet only acted in defense of our nation's asset. But this is still a disaster. The sinking of a ship is a grave matter."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "Okay. That's the last straw. If they want war, we'll bring them war."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "Wait. Can you go back to the part where they rammed into our flagship?"

232.speaker: Player_Romus
232.text: "WHAT!? How can you let such an incident take place?"

235.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
235.text: "I would advise caution, Your Majesty. Why don't we go over the report first?"

236.speaker: Lucita Azaro
236.text: "The admiral was given the authority to do *whatever it takes* not to let Palesian ships into the field, Your Majesty."

237.speaker: Lucita Azaro
237.text: "I'm afraid it was the Palesians who forced our hand."

238.speaker: Lucita Azaro
238.text: "I know it sounds ridiculous, Your Majesty."

239.speaker: Elena Werner
239.text: "It seemed to be a very intentional attack to provoke a response from us. And I think they have already succeeded in their plan."

241.speaker: Lucita Azaro
241.text: "Severe, Your Majesty. The impact compromised the hull's integrity, causing significant flooding in the engine room and adjacent compartments."

242.speaker: Lucita Azaro
242.text: "The admiral is waiting for your orders on how to deal with the situation."

243.speaker: Lucita Azaro
243.text: "We're still ascertaining the full extent, but preliminary reports suggest multiple injuries aboard the Valero."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "May the Divine's embrace be upon them, as they are healed by the source of all creation."

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "I hope for the Duke's sake that we have no Rizian casualties on board."

259.speaker: Player_Romus
259.text: "How did the engagement come to pass?"

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "I've heard enough. We can't spend any more time on this. We need to talk action."

265.speaker: Lucita Azaro
265.text: "According to the report, around 0400 hours, our naval forces, consisting of the flagship RRN Valero and three frigates, were patrolling the field, when the Palesian fleet, composed of three armed vessels, approached the disputed zone."

266.speaker: Lucita Azaro
266.text: "Despite repeated warnings, they continued their advance -- executing aggressive maneuvers."

267.speaker: Lucita Azaro
267.text: "The vessel that initiated the conflict attempted to bypass our blockade, accelerating towards the RRN Valero. In a reckless act, it rammed our flagship on the starboard side near the engine room."

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "They will pay for what they've done."

271.speaker: Lucita Azaro
271.text: "The Valero's propulsion system is heavily damaged, rendering the ship immobile. It is currently running on emergency power, but the flooding is critical."

272.speaker: Lucita Azaro
272.text: "The damage control teams are working tirelessly, but without external assistance, the risk of losing the flagship is very high. We estimate approximately 150 sailors are engaged in containment efforts as we speak."

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "Thank you for the reports. How do you think we should respond?"

276.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
276.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Incident_Naval_Hub1_Engagement"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Incident_Naval_Hub1_Damages"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Incident_Naval_Hub1_Casualties"] == true) == false

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "That sounds incredibly serious. We can't afford to lose our most valuable vessel by an attack like this."

281.speaker: Lucita Azaro
281.text: "Therefore we must act quickly, Your Majesty. Our fleet requires all the help we can give."

282.speaker: Lucita Azaro
282.text: "It sustained catastrophic damage post-collision. Seconds after the collision, it was shot at by multiple shots by our frigates. It capsized minutes after the ramming."

283.speaker: Lucita Azaro
283.text: "However, there are reasons to believe the collision was enough for it to sink -- and our shots may not be the main reason. It is too early to tell."

284.speaker: Lucita Azaro
284.text: "Our initial reports indicate survivors, but they are in perilous waters, Your Majesty."

285.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
285.text: "We can't simply let them drown. We have to do something."

286.speaker: Lucita Azaro
286.text: "We need our efforts focused on saving the Valero and our sailors inside."

288.speaker: Lucita Azaro
288.text: "The remaining two, upon seeing their companion's fate, ceased their advance and are currently held at a standoff distance. They're completely surrounded and outgunned."

289.speaker: Hugo Toras
289.text: "I agree. The admiral is waiting for our decision."

291.speaker: Hugo Toras
291.text: "We should consider capturing their remaining ships as a bargaining chip."

292.speaker: Elena Werner
292.text: "As I understand, we already have them surrounded."

297.speaker: Lucita Azaro
297.text: "Additionally, it is reported that there are survivors from the colliding ship. These are perilous waters, Your Majesty, so we do not know if we'll be able to manage a complete rescue operation without any help arriving."

298.speaker: Lucita Azaro
298.text: "Our fleet is currently fully focused on holding the remaining vessels in place, while trying to help the RRN Valero contain the flooding."

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "Duchess Azaro, what is the current status of the Palesian sailors? Do you think they can be saved?"

300.speaker: Player_Romus
300.text: "What's the distance to the nearest Rizian port for additional support?"

303.speaker: Lucita Azaro
303.text: "The closest port capable of dispatching a rescue team is on the mainland. Under current conditions, it would take several hours for a rescue team to reach the site."

304.speaker: Elena Werner
304.text: "Those sailors don’t have several hours in these waters, Your Grace. We're talking about the open sea, and they're likely without sufficient life-saving equipment."

305.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
305.text: "Your Majesty, leaving the Palesian sailors to fend for themselves could be seen as a severe dereliction of maritime duty. It would damage our international standing and the Duke would paint us as inhumane."

306.speaker: Hugo Toras
306.text: "This is their game, Councillor Esquibel. We can't let them write the rules for it."

307.speaker: Lucita Azaro
307.text: "However, focusing our efforts on the RRN Valero is crucial. It’s not only about saving our flagship -- which is our most expensive asset in the navy -- but also about preventing further loss of Rizian life."

308.speaker: Hugo Toras
308.text: "They provoked us, Your Majesty. We cannot simply keep playing their game."

309.speaker: Hugo Toras
309.text: "We need to give a strong response. I don't think we should let those ships go free. We need them as leverage."

310.speaker: Lucita Azaro
310.text: "Diverting our frigates to rescue could jeopardize the containment efforts on the Valero -- as well as risk the escape of the Palesian vessels."

311.speaker: Lucita Azaro
311.text: "Your Majesty, the sailors from the capsized vessel are in deep waters. Our frigates are currently occupied with both containing the situation aboard the RRN Valero and maintaining a perimeter around the remaining Palesian ships."

312.speaker: Lucita Azaro
312.text: "This has unfortunately left us with limited resources to mount an immediate rescue operation for the Palesian sailors. We can send a rescue team instead of diverting the resources of our fleet there."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "I don't think their sailors are a priority for us."

317.speaker: Vina Toras
317.text: "What about the sailors waiting for rescue?"

318.speaker: Elena Werner
318.text: "I agree, Your Grace. We need all the leverage against Pales. However, we cannot let them paint us as the aggressors when they clearly initiated the attack."

319.speaker: Elena Werner
319.text: "We should show compassion to their sailors."

320.speaker: Narrator
320.text: Laurento nodded in approval and quickly cut in.

322.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

325.speaker: Player_Romus
325.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn06_Incident_Naval_Hub2_Vina"] == false

326.speaker: Player_Romus
326.text: "I'll be honest. This incident is what we needed. Pales has long been a problem for us. We can use this."

330.speaker: Player_Romus
330.text: "Do you think Lespia could have any hand in this? This happened right after we cancelled our deal to cede the field to them."

331.speaker: Player_Romus
331.text: "I think I have the picture. Any last thoughts before I announce my decision?"

341.speaker: Sal Ignacius
341.text: "May the Divine grant you strength, Your Majesty."

342.speaker: Hugo Toras
342.text: "House Toras expects you to use this opportunity, Your Majesty."

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "I've heard enough. Pales has provoked us for the last time. We must prepare for war."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "Enough! Pales has dared to attack us, and such insolence demands retribution. I will show them the might of our kingdom. Prepare for war!"

354.speaker: Narrator
354.text: The councillors fell silent, a shocked look on their faces.

355.speaker: Player_Romus
355.text: "Our first duty is to our own. Focus all efforts on the RRN Valero. Dispatch a rescue team from the mainland for the Palesian sailors, but our immediate priority is saving the Valero and its crew. Keep the frigates focused on the Palesian ships."

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "We must attempt both rescues. Divert our frigates to aid the Palesian sailors as well as to continue to assist the Valero. Send for the mainland rescue team as backup."

357.speaker: Player_Romus
357.text: "Release the surrounded Palesian ships and instruct them to assist their sailors. Our frigates will focus on the Valero."

358.speaker: Player_Romus
358.text: "We will not attempt any rescue attempts for their sailors. Focus all rescue efforts on the RRN Valero. Dispatch a rescue team from the mainland for the flagship, but make sure our frigates are locked onto the Palesian ships in the meantime."

359.speaker: Vina Toras
359.text: "We should divert our efforts to rescue their sailors. Our priority should be human lives, regardless if it's Palesian or Rizian."

360.speaker: Vina Toras
360.text: "And if it was indeed their plan to push us into a corner -- we shouldn't fall for their trap. We should show the world that Rizia has compassion even when attacked."

362.speaker: Hugo Toras
362.text: "Without a greenlight from Lespia, the Duke would never do something like this. I think the connection is obvious."

363.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
363.text: "The Lespians are furious about it. But I don't think would have forced the Palesians to engage us directly like this."

364.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
364.text: "Even if that's true, that makes our situation only worse. We cannot afford to go against Lespia while half of the world is backing them."

365.speaker: Lucita Azaro
365.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. I will let the admiral know about your orders immediately."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "You already know about my intentions. We were waiting for them to initiate the attack -- and they did. It's time for us to bring them the war they wanted."

374.speaker: Lucita Azaro
374.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. I will let the admiral know about your orders immediately."

375.speaker: Lucita Azaro
375.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. I will let the admiral know about your orders immediately."

376.speaker: Lucita Azaro
376.text: "Understood, Your Majesty. I will let the admiral know about your orders immediately."

377.speaker: Hugo Toras
377.text: "It's a risky maneuver, Your Majesty. I hope this does not come at the cost of our flagship."

378.speaker: Hugo Toras
378.text: "It's a risky maneuver, Your Majesty. I hope this does not come at the cost of losing all of our leverage."

379.speaker: Hugo Toras
379.text: "It's a sound approach, Your Majesty. Our flagship represents Rizia's strength. We cannot afford to lose it -- nor the ships that attacked us."

380.speaker: Elena Werner
380.text: "I agree. It makes sense from a resource management perspective."

381.speaker: Elena Werner
381.text: "...Of course, the human cost is regrettable."

382.speaker: Elena Werner
382.text: "Juggling both responsibilities will be a challenge, but it may be the best course to mitigate broader consequences."

383.speaker: Elena Werner
383.text: "Releasing their ships is regrettable, but it may be the best course to mitigate broader consequences."

386.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
386.text: "This action may have diplomatic repercussions, Your Majesty."

390.speaker: Vina Toras
390.text: "I understand that the safety of our crew must be our paramount concern, but why don't we divert our ships that are already in the scene to help?"

391.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
391.text: "I agree with Your Highness, Your Majesty. This action may have diplomatic repercussions."

392.speaker: Lucita Azaro
392.text: "The rescue crew can still make it in time to save everyone."

393.speaker: Hugo Toras
393.text: "I believe His Majesty has already made his decision."

395.speaker: Sal Ignacius
395.text: "I believe His Majesty has already made his decision."

396.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
396.text: "This is the best course of action in my opinion."

400.speaker: Vina Toras
400.text: "I support the decision. This could foster goodwill, despite the complexities."

401.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
401.text: "I agree with Her Highness, Your Majesty."

402.speaker: Hugo Toras
402.text: "Our House and Rizian nationalists would have expected us to use this opportunity, though."

403.speaker: Hugo Toras
403.text: "I can only hope this doesn't turn into a larger problem."

404.speaker: Sal Ignacius
404.text: "I believe Your Majesty has already made his decision."

405.speaker: Player_Romus
405.text: "You've all already heard my decision. We'll call it here."

406.speaker: Player_Romus
406.text: "Hold on. I want to hear it. Is there anybody who has the guts to question my decision?"

412.speaker: Hugo Toras
412.text: "I believe that was all, Your Majesty."

415.speaker: Narrator
415.text: The councillors bowed in respect and left the room.

416.speaker: Hugo Toras
416.text: "I didn't expect to hear this, to say the least."

417.speaker: Hugo Toras
417.text: "But if Your Majesty thinks that time has finally come -- so be it."

418.speaker: Lucita Azaro
418.text: "We've all heard the King, Mr. Esquibel."

422.speaker: Vina Toras
422.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_Vina_LeadsDeal"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TankFactory_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_MilitaryEquipmentFactory_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_SupportVehicleFactory_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_TankFactory_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_MilitaryEquipmentFactory_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_SupportVehicleFactory_Completed"] == true) == false)

426.speaker: Elena Werner
426.text: "I have always been a proponent of peace."

427.speaker: Player_Romus
427.text: "I'm surprised you're not on Mr. Esquibel's side."

428.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
428.text: "And Princess Vina, Your Majesty? She's still in Pales, and they might try to keep her after what has happened."

429.speaker: Player_Romus
429.text: "Request her return immediately. We have to hope they will not do anything insane."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "I sent her there to teach her a lesson. A little time spent as a hostage will only help her learn it."

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "If they indeed try to take her as hostage, we'll burn Pales to the ground."

433.speaker: Lucita Azaro
433.text: "I wish it had not come to this. But our military is ready to rise to the challenge."

434.speaker: Elena Werner
434.text: "But in this instance, I cannot ignore the potential economic boom the Aureus field represents..."

435.speaker: Lucita Azaro
435.text: "We've all heard the King, ladies and gentlemen."

436.speaker: Lucita Azaro
436.text: "I will signal the general staff immediately."

438.speaker: Player_Romus
438.text: "Great. I trust you all to begin the preparations."

441.speaker: Narrator
441.text: Laurento looked at me but then averted his eyes.

442.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
442.text: "Have we considered all diplomatic avenues? Are we prepared for the repercussions?

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "If they do, call their bluff. Duke Reinhart knows better than to mess with the Royal Family."

449.speaker: Narrator
449.text: Laurento looked at me in shock.

451.speaker: Player_Romus
451.text: "Precisely. We cannot become an energy superpower without making sacrifices."

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "This has nothing to do with the gas field. It's blood for blood."

454.speaker: Narrator
454.text: Laurento turned to me for one last appeal.

455.speaker: Elena Werner
455.text: "Why? There is a time for diplomacy, and a time for action."

456.speaker: Narrator
456.text: Lucita gave him a furious stare.

457.speaker: Lucita Azaro
457.text: "What are you implying about our intelligence, Mr. Esquibel? Or the loyalty of our military officers?"

459.speaker: Lucita Azaro
459.text: "I didn't want to believe this. But could it be that Axel Reinhart never wanted peace with Rizia in the first place? Was the entire sale of the gas field a charade?"

463.speaker: Lucita Azaro
463.text: "I almost don't want to say it, but has Pales been playing the long game this entire time? Was Reinhart's supposed friendliness an act to gain our trust and reclaim territory?"
